sql: SELECT n.primary_name AS actor_name, MAX(t.start_year) - MIN(t.start_year) AS career_span FROM names n JOIN principals p ON p.name_id = n.id JOIN titles t ON t.id = p.title_id WHERE p.category_id IN ('actor', 'actress') AND t.start_year IS NOT NULL GROUP BY n.id, n.primary_name ORDER BY career_span DESC
optimized_sql: SELECT n.primary_name AS actor_name, MAX(t.start_year) - MIN(t.start_year) AS career_span FROM names n JOIN principals p ON p.name_id = n.id JOIN titles t ON t.id = p.title_id WHERE p.category_id IN ('actor', 'actress') AND t.start_year IS NOT NULL GROUP BY n.id, n.primary_name ORDER BY career_span DESC
